summary: @servicetitan/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS module (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are heavily obfuscated with a token-rotation string decoder (large numeric array, shuffled identifiers like `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `WV8StW`). `math_init.js` is not referenced from the declared stylelint main (`dist/index.js`) and is only reachable via the preinstall dropper. The alternate-runtime execution path evades Node-based instrumentation and causes opaque, attacker-controlled bytes to run on the installer's machine on `npm install`. A stylelint configuration package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
